description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the SearchResultsController in SuiteCRM, testing its display functionality under various conditions such as with results found, no results, and pagination.

classes.name: SearchResultsControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of SearchResultsController display method, including pagination and search result scenarios.

methods.name: testDisplayFoundOnePage
methods.description: Tests the display method with exactly one page of results (15 items) and then with an additional 5 items added, verifying the total count display.

methods.name: testDisplayFoundOne
methods.description: Tests the display method when a single search result is found, verifying that the result content is rendered.

methods.name: testDisplayNotFound
methods.description: Tests the display method when no search results are found, verifying the appropriate no-results message is displayed.
